caption:
We can repair limiting beliefs, including the one that tells us as parents that it is not safe to feel. 

Comment 👉EMOTIONS and I’ll send you 14 common parenting phrases not to say if you are raising an emotionally healthy family, including “Oh come on, it’s not that bad.” 

Anyone else hear that one growing up?! 

Is there a belief you inherited that you plan NOT to pass down to your kids? 

Please share it in the comments. And thank you for being a #cyclebreaker.
